issues.description: Field Farm.animals: the problem statement (Instructions in problem_statement.md) requires the Farm to aggregate animals using a List<Animal> and to initialize it with an ArrayList in the no-arg constructor. The solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java in the solution repository) declares the field as Set<Animal> and initializes it with new HashSet<>(), and its getter/setter use Set<Animal>. This mismatch between the specified collection type (List/ArrayList) and the solution's collection type (Set/HashSet) can confuse students about which collection to use, changes semantics (ordering and duplicate handling), and may cause tests or expectations about order/duplicates to differ from the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's Farm class match the problem specification: change the field declaration to private List<Animal> animals; initialize it in the no-arg constructor with this.animals = new ArrayList<>(); and update the getter/setter signatures to use List<Animal>. Adjust addAnimal, feedAllAnimals, and singFarmSong iteration code to work with List instead of Set. This preserves the intended teaching point (using List/ArrayList) and restores the specified ordering/duplicate semantics.
